## 2. In-Depth Material Engineering & Sizing Guide

### A. 3D Acrylic Nameplates
- **Material Composition**: High-grade cast acrylic (3mm base with 3mm to 5mm laser-cut embossed 3D lettering).
- **Durability**: 100% waterproof, rustproof, and UV-stabilized against sunlight yellowing.
- **Lighting**: Available with energy-efficient waterproof LED strips (3000K Warm White or 6500K Cool White) with an external 12V 2A DC power adapter included.
- **Ideal Placement**: Modern flat entrance doors, apartment corridors, and interior foyer walls.

### B. Handcrafted Natural Wooden Nameplates
- **Wood Species**: Natural Grade-A Teak wood, Mango wood, Steam Beech, and moisture-resistant HDMR/MDF.
- **Surface Treatment**: Multi-stage sanding coated with 3 layers of exterior-grade marine PU (Polyurethane) lacquer and anti-termite sealant.
- **Engraving & Detailing**: CNC precision carving or laser-etched lettering, accented with 3D golden acrylic raised typography.
- **Ideal Placement**: Bungalow entrances, villa front doors, and covered outdoor entryways.

### C. ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel) Nameplates
- **Structure**: Thermally bonded dual aluminium skin sandwiching a solid mineral/polyethylene core.
- **Weather Resistance**: Highly resistant to rain, extreme Gujarat summers, humidity, and direct UV rays.
- **Finishes**: Wood grain textures (Walnut, Teak, Teakwood Burl), brushed metallic silver/gold, and matte architectural charcoal.
- **Ideal Placement**: Exterior bungalow compound gates, outdoor exposed pillars, and main boundary walls.

### D. Architectural Mild Steel (MS) Nameplates
- **Fabrication**: Heavy-duty 2mm to 3mm solid cold-rolled mild steel precision cut via industrial fiber laser machines.
- **Anti-Corrosion Treatment**: 7-tank chemical pre-treatment (degreasing, phosphating, passivating) followed by electrostatically applied thermo-cured architectural powder coating.
- **Colors**: Matte Black, Textured Sand-Charcoal, Antique Copper, and Off-White.
- **Ideal Placement**: Main gates of modern contemporary villas, luxury farmhouses, and exterior brick/stone walls.

### E. Stainless Steel (SS 304) Nameplates
- **Grade**: Exclusively austenitic SS 304 (18/8 Chromium-Nickel alloy) offering zero rust even in humid or coastal climates.
- **Finishes**: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) titanium electroplating in Mirror Gold, Rose Gold, and Brushed Hairline Satin.
- **Etching**: Deep chemical acid-etching with baked enamel color filling for professional names, advocates, doctors, and chartered accountants.
- **Ideal Placement**: Corporate offices, luxury bungalow main gates, and executive entrance doors.

### F. Hand-Poured Resin Art Nameplates
- **Artisan Technique**: Multi-layer crystal-clear epoxy resin casting with a minimum of 48–72 hours curing time between pours.
- **Inclusions**: Real pressed natural flowers, gold/silver leaf flakes, metallic alcohol inks, and cultured stone marble pigments.
- **Ideal Placement**: Indoor foyers, apartment entrance doors, and luxury personalized gifting.

## 3. Customization & Script Support
Decorom's live online customizer enables buyers to preview their exact names before purchase:
- **Languages**: English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, and Sanskrit fonts.
- **Symbols**: Lord Ganesha, Om, Swastik, Krishna Flute with Morpankh, Jain Prateek & Navkar Mantra, Ik Onkar, Kalash, and Tree of Life.
- **Mounting Kit**: Every order includes all required mounting accessories (brass mirror screws, concealed brackets, or heavy-duty 3M VHB tape) with an installation guide.

## 4. Ordering, Dispatch & Pan-India Fulfillment
- **Dispatch SLA**: Handcrafted and dispatched within 2 to 3 business days from design confirmation.
- **Delivery**: Next-day doorstep delivery within Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar; 4 to 6 working days express courier across all states in India.
- **Warranty**: 1-year manufacturer warranty against letter detachment, manufacturing defects, and LED lighting failure.
